scripts.docker:restart: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.prisma:reset: pnpm --filter @praxis/credentials-service exec prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && pnpm --filter @praxis/projects-service exec prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && pnpm --filter @praxis/permissions-service exec prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && pnpm --filter @praxis/tasks-service exec prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && pnpm --filter @praxis/assistant-service exec prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed
scripts.prisma:deploy: pnpm --filter @praxis/credentials-service exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @praxis/projects-service exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @praxis/permissions-service exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @praxis/tasks-service exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @praxis/assistant-service exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.setup:shared: pnpm --filter @praxis/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @praxis/observability run build
scripts.setup:credentials: pnpm run setup:shared && pnpm --filter @praxis/credentials-service run prisma:generate
scripts.setup:projects: pnpm run setup:shared && pnpm --filter @praxis/projects-service run prisma:generate
scripts.setup:permissions: pnpm run setup:shared && pnpm --filter @praxis/permissions-service run prisma:generate
scripts.setup:tasks: pnpm run setup:shared && pnpm --filter @praxis/tasks-service run prisma:generate
scripts.setup:assistant: pnpm run setup:shared && pnpm --filter @praxis/assistant-service run prisma:generate
